settings.sandboxMode: Bash Sandbox Mode (not supported on Windows)
settings.sandboxModeHint: Enabled fails closed and disables Bash when isolation cannot start. Enabled (disable on failure) falls back to an unrestricted shell. Disabled always uses an unrestricted shell and is the default. Windows always uses an unrestricted shell and ignores this setting. Reconnect or restart HogAgent to apply.
settings.explicitCacheHint: Enable Anthropic-style cache_control for Qwen models. Caches system prompt, tools, and conversation prefix to reduce latency and cost.
settings.compressorEnabledHint: Off by default. Disabling applies after the current task finishes and removes retrieval tools. Enabling requires restart.
settings.compressThresholdHint: Tool results exceeding this token count are auto-compressed. Default: 5000.
settings.subagentMaxTurnsHint: Maximum LLM turns before sub-agent is force-stopped. Default: 50.
settings.memoryEnabledHint: Enable cross-session memory via Gateway KB MCP Server. Registers memory_save / memory_search tools. Takes effect on next session.
settings.memoryMcpKbUrlHint: Gateway KB MCP Server endpoint. Auto-filled by Gateway; leave as-is unless customized.
settings.showCacheStatsHint: Display cache_read/cache_write token counts in LLM usage info.
